prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Regional Dispatch Center (RDC, Juniper) intakes Emergency Medical Services requests, maintains incident/audit/operation records under approved access/retention controls, records contact attempts, and logs any Shift Commander capability restriction rationale/scope/duration. Aliases/callsigns: Call Taker Mara=Larkspur; Triage Supervisor=Copperfield; Shift Commander=Sundial; Radio Coordinator=Mistral; Kestrel=capacity/pediatric-limits confirmer. Larkspur enters/updates incident data, confirms incident ID/facility, keeps caller connected when feasible during alternate-channel crew contact, and verifies arrival. Copperfield assigns priority/response level/basis, flags immediate radio access, validates surge/overrides/duplicates, and reviews cases where acuity decisions/escalation timing may affect patient risk. Computer Aided Dispatch weighs distance/access/travel/restrictions/weather/closures/queues/demand/capacity/crew readiness/unit capability/coverage; CAD console shall display latest confirmed unit status with confirmation time/source and be scenario-tested before regional release. Ambulance Coordination Platform consolidates position/status/matching/time-stamped changes/approved destination/instructions, tracks mutual aid separately, preserves queued updates during brief interruptions, flags reconciliation, and is monitored for availability/response time/data integrity/interface failures; changes require operational/clinical/security/continuity impact assessment. Release approvals identify change owner, test evidence, limitations, rollback. If voice fails, approved data channel is used and attempts recorded; after restoration delayed reports are reconciled by timestamp and discrepancies preserved. Hospital Liaison Desk coordinates destination/capacity/acceptance/handover, uses telephone during network disruption, contributes protected observations to reviews. Emergency Department staff receive/acknowledge backup arrival changes. Paramedic Crew acknowledges/repeats instructions, reports status/position/route issues, reassesses pediatric patients, avoids uncertain areas lacking confirmed instructions; Ambulance Unit 417 reports arrival/handover and restored-contact safe status/position. Mistral manages radio/talkgroups/change cards, uses South Access Lane Notice for accountable review; Regional Radio Network/interfaces are checked after maintenance/configuration before normal use. Fleet Maintenance Cell reports faults, uses Mutual Aid Release Form, schedules preventive work by manufacturer/service history/requirements; maintenance records include asset ID, work/parts/return-to-service. Sundial approves exceptions/surge/mutual aid, receives Coverage Gap Bulletin, may restrict risky defective capability, reviews significant events with Regional Medical Director, and controls shift handover.
